name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible tooling or development-build issue
title: ''

---

Describe the problem and expected behaviour.

Provide the source commit, tool version, command and operating system. For Android work, include Discord version code, APK hashes, device model, Android API, ABI and plugin/theme configuration. State which parts were actually tested.

List reproduction steps and include the smallest relevant error output. Remove tokens, private content, device serial numbers, account identifiers and signing secrets. Do not attach proprietary APKs or extracted application code.
